paragraphs: The Viano 3.0 uses the M272 - a 3.0-litre V6 petrol engine fitted across the W639 generation from 2003 to 2014. The M272 was one of Mercedes' mainstream V6 petrol units of that era, also used across the C-Class, E-Class, and other models. The Viano was discontinued in 2014 and succeeded by the V-Class, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every VIANO 3.0 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the VIANO 3.0 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the Viano 3.0 uses a single engine family across its production, compatibility is relatively straightforward - but matching the exact engine code and specification is still critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Viano quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
